messages.subject: Survey design issue
parts:
Hi,



I am designing a survey based on systematic grid points with a random
starting point. This will allocate survey points to a study area containing
three strata. I can go through the following actions:



Project Browser, Design Tab, Design Details, Properties



However, when I want to move from the General Properties tab to the Effort
Allocation tab it states:



'An unexpected error occurred while checking the options on this page.
Please check they are valid and change any incorrect values.'



.and I am unable to continue.



While designing this survey, a colleague and I have managed to resolve some
of the issues relating to projection and coordinate systems and I am not
sure if it is linked to this. However, in a similar design with similar
problems with the aid of this colleague we were able to go past this problem
and enter the effort as we required. I could not see any difference between
what she had done and the settings of the study area and strata except for
one point: the strata was projected and also had additional project
parameters (which apparently she had not entered herself). The projection
and parameters had to be removed subsequently for mapping for the survey
points, but did not affect the issue above.



Is this problem related to something I have missed in the design, or is it
possibly a problem with my computer? I've looked on the listserv archive and
I can't find anything related to this.



Many thanks in advance



Hugo
